record.label: Spacetime cost of the clean-ancilla circuit
record.description: Appendix H.4 reports $Q=6{,}033$ logical qubits and a spacetime cost $Q\cdot\mathcal{T}=605{,}980{,}010{,}227{,}389$ for one femtosecond of evolution. The time-evolution budget excludes initial-state preparation and observable readout, as in the baseline.
